messages:
tara: quick async — where are we on fenrir-6b intake? need green on licensing, perf, and runtime canary by EOW.

mike: perf update — baseline run on p3.8x: single-stream ~45ms @512, throughput looks fine. saw a KV-cache regression without the runtime patch. PR #4123 filed.

jess: legal check — initial license looks like it has a non-commercial clause. pinged upstream for clarification, asked for full license text + weight provenance. aiming to have a clear answer by Tue.

sam: devex question — can we add it to catalog staging so integrators can smoke-test? I can make it private if license is sketchy.

lee: runtime notes — KV-cache fix is in a branch, will merge after review. planning canary tomorrow 11:30 PDT. need infra ack for canary hosts.

mike: also saw memory spike >1024 seq. suspect attention kernel edge case. opening perf ticket and attaching trace.

jess: if upstream confirms NC clause, hosted API is a no-go. Dedicated/private still okay. I'll put flags in the intake doc depending on reply.

tara: owners clarifying: mike -> perf, jess -> legal, lee -> runtime/canary, sam -> catalog + devex. deps: eng-runtime PR #4123, legal upstream reply, infra canary hosts. Milestones: license cleared (Tue), perf signoff (Thu), staging added (Fri) => soft launch next week.

sam: added staging entry: /catalog/staging/fenrir-6b (visibility: private). tagged fenrir-6b/quant-8bit for later.

mike: CR link: https://git.redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4123 — bench command added to repo: 
```
./bench --model fenrir-6b --seq 512 --batch 8 --kv-cache
```
run that and post numbers.

jess: uploaded current legal notes to intake doc: https://redwood.docs/models/intake/1867001234 — added a section "license-clarity".

lee: canary checklist (short): smoke tests, latency dashboard alerting, fallback policy to small-approx, monitor KV cache faults. will post runbook snippet in #eng-runtime before deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: eng-runtime/canary -> 2026-03-20T11:30:00Z (initiated by lee).

tara: please add final signoffs by Thu 18:00 PT. I’ll consolidate and confirm launch window.

mike: +1 from perf if KV patch holds during canary.

jess: holding final until upstream clarifies license text. will update thread immediately.

sam: staging integration tests currently passing. will run end-to-end tests Wed morning.

lee: canary window locked; I'll monitor metrics and revert if anomalies.

tara: thanks — looping in @legal-bot for follow-up with upstream.

legal-bot: Received intake. Assigned to @jess. Will notify when upstream responds.

mike: FYI model FP16 size ~14.2GB. quant plan: try Q4-INT8 (calib) then Q8 for cost target.

jess: upstream replied: license = CC-BY-NC-4.0. that blocks hosted offering. recommending private/dedicated only unless we get exception.

tara: change of plan noted. mark fenrir-6b as "private/dedicated only" in catalog. Sam — update tags/pricing config and notify pricing.

sam: done — tags updated: [private-only, dedicated-ok]. pinged pricing & growth for pricing guidance.

tara: great. final asks: everyone drop a one-liner signoff when ready. I’ll close daily async after consolidation. :white_check_mark:

mike: signed off for perf (pending KV patch in canary).

jess: will sign off once license exception or confirmation arrives. tracking.

sam: signed off on staging and tags. running e2e Wed.

lee: monitoring during canary. will report metrics.

tara: thanks all — will update the launch tracker and open follow-up tickets for post-launch observability and billing.

end of thread.
